scenario: Office renovation — private conference room reservation
email_content:
Hi Team,

We wanted to give you a heads-up about upcoming renovation work in the office. To improve our shared spaces, we'll be updating the 3rd floor kitchen and lounge area on Monday and Tuesday next week. Please see the details below.

CONSTRUCTION TIMELINE
- Start Date: Monday, August 17
- Estimated Completion: Tuesday, August 18
- Affected Area: 3rd Floor Kitchen/Lounge and the surrounding desks (Rows C–E)
- Working Hours: Contractors on-site 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Monday–Tuesday

WHAT TO EXPECT
- Noise: Expect intermittent drilling and hammering noise, primarily between 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM. Noise-canceling headphones are available for checkout at the front desk if needed.
- Kitchen Closure: The 3rd floor kitchen will be closed on both days. The 2nd floor kitchen will remain open for all staff during this time.
- Dust/Air Quality: Construction dividers will be in place, but if you have any sensitivities, please let us know so we can accommodate.

TEMPORARY DESK ASSIGNMENT
Your desk is in Row D, so you'll be temporarily relocated to the 4th floor open desks near the east windows (see attached seating map) on Monday and Tuesday. Please relocate your belongings by end of day Friday, August 14. IT will help reconnect monitors and equipment at your temporary desk if needed — just submit a ticket by August 12.

PRIVATE CONFERENCE ROOMS
The open desks on the 4th floor are not suitable for private calls or meetings. Conference Rooms A and C (2nd floor) can be reserved in 1-hour blocks on Monday and Tuesday. If you need a private room, reply with the day(s) and time(s) you need it and we'll book it for you.

If you have questions or specific concerns (accessibility, equipment, noise sensitivity, etc.), just reply to this email.

Thanks,
Facilities / Office Coordinator
